scope: Local working tree: pure packed Bml scalar, bounded rules/synthesis, facade and optional integrations
limits: Arithmetic construction is structural; finite-real evaluation can fail or lose precision.
mul/div require positive operands; recip/sqrt positive input; pow positive base and exponent.
Float synthesis is partial, budgeted and checked against configurable tolerance; negative zero is normalized.
Natural-base transcendental functions, trigonometry and complex evaluation are not implemented by this change.
No claim of arbitrary-float coverage, numerical stability, compression, inference correctness or speedup.
Opt-in model, ptrace/perf and distributed instrumentation tests were not run.
